content.title: Where are the irrigation ditches in Arvada?
content.summary: There are over 60 irrigation ditches that run through Arvada in nearly every part of the city. Three of the largest ditches include: Farmers’ Highline Canal Croke Canal Church Ditch The Arvada Ditch Map shows all of the ditches in Arvada. Google Maps also has some ditches mapped and labeled.
